title: 模拟一 · 个人信息与兴趣爱好
sourceBadge: 官方公开样题结构改编
sourceLabel: 依据 Cambridge A2 Key for Schools 公开口语样题的题型与流程重新编写
sourceReference: 公开样题 Speaking Test 1 · Part 1–2（非原题逐字复制）
visualAlt: 五种课后兴趣活动：踢足球、阅读、绘画、弹吉他和玩桌游
visualQuestion: Talk about the activities. Say what you like or do not like and give reasons.
part1Questions: Good morning. What is your name, and how do you spell your first name?
Where do you live? What do you like about your neighbourhood?
Tell me about a subject you enjoy at school.
What do you usually do after school? Why do you like it?

part2.instruction: Now, in this part of the test, you will talk with another student about activities after school. Look at the pictures. Listen to the other student's idea, respond to it, and give reasons for your opinion.
part2.exchangeA: Candidate B says: I think playing football is fun because we can be active together. What do you think?
part2.exchangeB: Candidate B says: Reading is quieter, but it can be very interesting. Which activity is better to do with friends?
part2.followUp: Which activity in the pictures would you most like to do this weekend, and why?
